title: I thought I was crazy…
content: I posted the strangest event of my life that happened last fall and I had a dream about it a few days ago and remembered it, went to reread the thread and someone said to post the story here. I can’t believe this is real- I’m feeling such a sense of relief Long story short - last August I took a …recreational substance. This doesn’t cause hallucinations, it’s just a relexant with some feel goodness that make/ uh …adult activities much more enjoyable My friend came to visit and after we did it together and did some of our events- I went to take a shower. I was a little exhausted and felt kind of weak - the drug was also hitting me a bit and I decided to just sit down in the shower and hang my head kind of out of it to keep safe. It was pure euphoria to sit there in the calm shower with some music playing and the water the perfect temperature and I closed my eyes and just enjoyed the vibes- few minutes later my friend knocked on the door and came in to see if I was okay. I shook it off, got dressed and met him outside and asked him: “wait did you end up buying anything?” He looked at me strangely and I repeated the question and said “at the mall…what did we buy there?” I looked at my phone, and could see why he had come in to check on me, I was in the shower for almost 45 minutes He looked at me like I was crazy. And even though logically it was starting to make sense - I was absolutely positive I had just been to a mall. I could FEEL my feet were sore as though I’d been walking around for hours. I had a sudden weird memory of “lowering” into the subway system that reminded me of NYC but much crazier, larger and frenetic I lived in a remote village. He had arrived an hour ago. There was no logic to this at all- but I was absolutely convinced I had just been at this mall for hours in the space of minutes I couldn’t shake it for the rest of the day and that night I couldn’t sleep. I told my friend about it and he just thought I took too much or was having a reaction or maybe it was a dream but after finding this as our shared experience …I’m completely convinced this is real
